definition4_locally_envy_free.comment: Context-free translation of the complete elaborated Lean declaration; all carriers, visible premises, quantifiers, formulas, and conclusions are retained.
definition4_locally_envy_free.tex_statement: For any bidder and slot types with decidable bidder equality, position environment, position mechanism, value and bid profiles, number of allocated positions, and bidder-at-rank and slot-at-rank maps, the source Definition 4 predicate holds if and only if the bids are a static Nash equilibrium, every allocated rank is assigned to its specified bidder and slot by the mechanism outcome, and at every adjacent allocated pair the bidder at the lower rank weakly prefers that rank's click-through-rate-weighted value net of its own per-click payment to the rank immediately above with that upper-rank payment.
definition4_locally_envy_free.validator: Codex EOS07 source-first v10 full-formalization audit

stable_assignment.comment: Context-free translation of the complete elaborated Lean declaration; all carriers, visible premises, quantifiers, formulas, and conclusions are retained.
stable_assignment.tex_statement: For any bidder and slot types, position environment, position outcome, and bidder values, the outcome is a stable assignment if and only if it is feasible and individually rational and, whenever bidder j is assigned slot s, every bidder i's click-through-rate-weighted value net of j's per-click payment is at most bidder i's utility in the outcome.
